title: Kammler negotiating with the Western Allies

tellings.quote: There was quite a bit of evidence that Kammler had been in negotiations with the Allied Western Allies before the end of the war.

plain: Hans Kammler, the SS general who ran Nazi Germany's secret weapons projects, is said to have been negotiating with the Western Allies before the end of the war in 1945. The aviation journalist Nick Cook tells Michels there was "quite a bit of evidence" for this, without naming it. If true, Kammler may have traded Germany's most advanced technology to the Americans or British in exchange for his own escape.
